title: Values on a natural-number segment
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers. If the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$ agree with the entries of $l$ viewed as integers, then for every index $i<|l|$, $\mu(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by the natural number $l_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with the entries of $l$, viewed as integers, at every index in the segment starting at $a$
